9082.name: Bonescythe Gauntlets
desc: Rohan the Assassin at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands will make Bonescythe Gauntlets if you bring him the following: 1 Desecrated Gauntlets, 8 Wartorn Leather Scraps, 1 Arcanite Bar and 5 Cured Rugged Hides.
objectives: Rohan the Assassin at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands will make Bonescythe Gauntlets if you bring him the following: 1 Desecrated Gauntlets, 8 Wartorn Leather Scraps, 1 Arcanite Bar and 5 Cured Rugged Hides.
details: If you want Bonescythe made, you're going to have to supply the materials.$B$BEnter Naxxramas, the big floating city of death in the sky up there, and find desecrated armor and wartorn armor scraps. Bring those back along with the materials to put everything together and you'll have your Bonescythe. Oh, and you'll need to pay me for my troubles... I'll supply the bones.
progress: How do you expect me to get anything done without the items I requested?
completion: These gauntlets could probably substitute as weapons if absolutely necessary. Wear them with pride!

9106.name: Plagueheart Shoulderpads
desc: Mataus the Wrathcaster at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands will make Plagueheart Shoulderpads if you bring him the following: 1 Desecrated Shoulderpads, 12 Wartorn Cloth Scraps, 2 Mooncloth and 3 Cured Rugged Hides.
objectives: Mataus the Wrathcaster at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands will make Plagueheart Shoulderpads if you bring him the following: 1 Desecrated Shoulderpads, 12 Wartorn Cloth Scraps, 2 Mooncloth and 3 Cured Rugged Hides.
details: I make no pretenses, maggot. The darkness Plagueheart items hold could very well destroy the both of us. That is why the price is so high. If I'm going to die, it's going to be as a rich man.$B$BAnd I don't give an ounce of gnoll spit how you die, only that you do as I ask. Bring me what I require and we will both benefit - or die; but I've already explained this...
progress: You got some missing parts for the quest please go and get them all!
completion: Exellent $N !$B , you got everything just as i asked and now i can make a Plagueheart Shoulderpads.

9154.name: Light's Hope Chapel
desc: Deliver the Call to Arms Announcement to the Keeper of the Rolls at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands.
objectives: Deliver the Call to Arms Announcement to the Keeper of the Rolls at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands.
details: The Scourge have returned in greater numbers than we have seen before. This must be the doing of the Lich King! The Argent Dawn is recruiting all willing and capable men and women to defend our lands.
If we share common cause, take this document to the Keeper of the Rolls at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands.
completion: The Argent Dawn placed the call for aid, and you, among others, have answered. There is no time for us to provide you with training. Our faith is placed in your abilities, and that you will join us in throwing back this Scourge threat.
progress: You've come to join our order, have you not?

9178.name: Craftsman's Writ - Dense Weightstone
desc: Deliver 120 Dense Weightstones and the Craftsman's Writ - Dense Weightstone - to Packmaster Stonebruiser at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands.
objectives: Deliver 120 Dense Weightstones and the Craftsman's Writ - Dense Weightstone - to Packmaster Stonebruiser at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands.

progress: Filling a work order, $C?
completion: Yep, these will come in handy for the infantry's bashin' weapons.

desc: Deliver 20 Major Healing Potions and the Craftsman's Writ - Major Healing Potion - to Packmaster Stonebruiser at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands.

9226.name: Superior Armaments of Battle - Revered Amongst the Dawn
desc: For 7 Insignias of the Dawn and 7 Insignias of the Crusade you may choose an item from the Argent Dawn's treasure cache.
objectives: For 7 Insignias of the Dawn and 7 Insignias of the Crusade you may choose an item from the Argent Dawn's treasure cache.
details: For 7 Insignias of the Dawn and 7 Insignias of the Crusade you may choose an item from the Argent Dawn's treasure cache.
progress: Choose carefully. There are no refunds.
completion: Good day, $N. It was a pleasure doing business with you.

9250.name: Frame of Atiesh
desc: Find someone that will help you in recovering the last two pieces of the staff and ridding it of evil.
objectives: Find someone that will help you in recovering the last two pieces of the staff and ridding it of evil.
details: With the frame formed, Atiesh is nearly whole. Only the head and base of the staff are now missing. There is also a minor issue regarding the staff being a conduit for Sargeras's evil.
Find someone that can assist you in locating the remaining pieces and exorcising the evil from the staff.
completion: The archmages have died.
Do not mourn their passing, $N. All such things are fated. Just as you holding the staff of the Guardian was fated...
progress: It was her time, mortal.

9322.name: Wild Fires in Kalimdor
desc: Visit the Midsummer camps located in Azshara, Silithus, Un'Goro Crater, and Winterspring, then return to the Festival Flamekeeper.
objectives: Visit the Midsummer camps located in Azshara, Silithus, Un'Goro Crater, and Winterspring, then return to the Festival Flamekeeper.
details: The Midsummer Fire Festival is celebrated everywhere in Azeroth, and the diverse land of Kalimdor is no exception. You look fit to travel -- perhaps a journey is in order.

Midsummer cannot be truly appreciated unless you've seen the blistering blue fires abroad. The celebrants have lit fires in chilly western Winterspring, northeastern Azshara, near Valor's Rest in the wastes of Silithus, and by the entrance to lush Un'Goro. Return once your journey is complete.
completion: Your spirit glows with the warmth of the Kalimdor fires, friend. Is the heat not invigorating? Once the power fades from you, perhaps these will help rekindle the feeling.
progress: Are the flames of Kalimdor burning brightly?

65602.name: What Is Love?
details:
You will need a powerful reagent to tempt an incubus -- an object that represents great devotion and love.

With my scrying, I have located a small figurine that should be suitable for your ritual.

Thousands of years ago, the figurine belonged to a young couple. The original owners are no more, but their keepsake has survived to the present day.

Follow the road north into Ashenvale, then west and past Maestra's Post. You will see a house nestled amongst the trees. There you will find what you seek.
progress: You've returned. Successfully, I assume?
completion: <Gakin turns the wooden figurine over in his hand.> $B I sense the emotional energy residing within this artifact, undiminished by the passing of time. The incubus will be drawn to it like a fly to honey. $B Takar never disappoints.

91282.name: A Second Home
objectives: Find the fortress of Bandarion Keep and report to Breton Samuels there.
details: It is encouraging to see my newly risen brothers and sisters thrive as you have. It is only through community and shared faith that we can truly realize our full potential however, and to that end we've begun to form a new paladin order right here in Tirisfal.
If you wish to learn more, you should visit our monastery at Northface Rock. It is called Bandarion Keep. It's on the bluffs just northwest of the Solliden Farmstead, and should be hard to miss.

92434.name: Blood in the Streets
objectives: Find a way into Dalaran along the Lordamere Lake.
*Grimy Key (provided)
details: Whatever caused Dalaran's barrier to lower has left the city in turmoil. With you having dealt with their patrols, there is no better time than now to make our way inside and discover their secrets.

Take the key you found at the internment camp and seek out their sewers along the northern border of the city. With luck, those mages had no reason to put a ward over such a... disagreeable point of entry.
progress: Stay your weapon, <race>.
I think you will find that key won't be enough to get past my wards. You didn't truly think we would leave such a vulnerability open at a time like this, did you?

92458.name: Heart of Disruption
objectives: Collect the Arcane Mote for the Image of Archmage Modera near the City of Dalaran.
* Arcane Mote
* Dalaran Sewer Key (provided)
details: Whatever disturbed the ley lines, it started at the top of the Violet Citadel. A thunderous crash rang out from the parlors above, and now we are overrun with rampant arcane power. It's taking all we have just to keep the wards in place.
We cannot afford to stall any longer. We need help.

The Kirin Tor are busy inside, but you will still need a less public approach to gain entry. Take this key and meet me in the citadel once you've made your way into the city. We must put an end to this disruption.

92482.name: The Way of the Hunter
objectives: Read the Scribbled Note and then speak with Tai'ree Farsight in Thendal Grove.
* Scribbled Note (provided)
details: While you were away dealing with our vuldren problem, our resident hunter trainer--Tai'ree Farsight--left this note for you. You can find her just over yonder near the center of the village. Read the note then seek her out.
progress: <Tai'ree nods at you curtly.>

92698.name: What Is My Purpose?
objectives: Speak with Aamelia Windfield about the Malfunctioning Cyclone Construct.

94978.name: Taming the Beast
objectives:
Use the Taming Rod to tame a Windsong Crawler found near bodies of water.
Practice your skills, then return the Taming Rod to Quel'ana Quickgale in Valanaar.

95314.name: That Shadowvale Green Elixir
objectives: Collect 8 Bottles of Whispering Elixir from Shadowvale, then return to Carolai Anise in Brill.
*Bottle of Whispering Elixir (8)
details: Before the Scourge invasion, the reclusive village of Shadowvale was known for its Whispering Elixir. Distilled from herbs found only in Tyr's Fall, the elixir was sought by apothecaries, mystics, and poisoners alike even after being banned in the city.

I've had requests from a number of buyers eager to get their hands on some elixir. Travel to the ruins of Shadowvale deep in the Whispering Forest to the west. I'm prepared to offer significant compensation if you can recover some bottles for me.
progress: I trust you did not get lost?

96394.name: The Restless Dead
objectives: Kill 15 Enraged Apparitions, 10 Tormented Souls and put the spirit of Anvilmar to rest.
* slain (15)
* slain (10)
details: Something has disturbed the tombs down in the Hall of Thanes, and strange noises have been heard coming from deep within the vaults. The spirits of the dead are light sleepers, and whatever is going on down there seems to have startled them.
Head down there and see what you can do about that for us. If any of the dead are awake--well, put them back down!
progress: I don't have time for ghouls and ghosts. I have a job to do down here.

96658.name: Camping 101: Cooking
details: So you want to learn more about camping, huh? Good for you, <class>. The first step any adventurer needs to take is to become a cook and learn how to make a campfire.
Cooking's not just about making tasty foods. It's also the foundation for your camp.
objectives: Speak with <quest ender> in <town> to learn to become a cook.
*Learn cooking from <quest ender> in <town>
completion: With this, you'll be able to set up a camp anywhere out in the wilderness. What you've learned is just the basics, so you won't be able to place too many furnishings around it.
Raise your cooking skill and you might just be able to learn to make even bigger fires.
You can also learn the basics of furnishing your campsites from other tradeskill trainers if you're savvy in their skills.
progress: A good campfire is the foundation to any good camp.

96874.name: This Is Spinal Axe
objectives: Ug'thok in Orgrimmar wants you to collect 5 Weathered Spines from beasts in Thunder Ridge, along with 5 Rough Grinding Stones.

96898.name: Remnants of War
objectives: Gather 12 Necrotic Crystal Fragments in .
*Necrotic Crystal Fragment (12)
details: It wasn't long ago that the citadel of Naxxramas bore down upon this city, intent on wiping the Forsaken off the map. Both the Forsaken and the Argent Dawn lost much that day to secure the future of the Forsaken.

During the battle, the great necrotic focusing crystal hanging beneath Naxxramas was shattered and its fragments were scattered all over this area. I suspect that is what the cultists are here for. Help me recover the fragments and deprive the scourge of them.
progress: I'd advise you not come into too much physical contact with those crystals. Even shattered and spent, the lingering magic in these necrotic crystals is highly dangerous.

97282.name: Stormy Potential
objectives: Bring 5 Charged Thunder Lizard Organs to Rezlak near Drygulch Ravine.

98362.name: To Thunder Bluff
objectives: Return to Thunder Bluff and speak with Turak Runetotem on the Elder Rise.
details: The time has come for us to part ways once again, young one, as the application of your lessons takes you back to whom that sent you to me. It would seem your instructor, Turak Runetotem, has found a worthy pupil in you. I believe I see one as well. Heed his lessons and you shall soon be able to draw upon the Great Cat Spirit to take its shape.
Go back to whence you came. When the time is right, we will meet again.

99130.name: An Enticing Offer
objectives: Collect ingredients for murloc bait.
